popup.auto.startLabel: Also start recording by itself on this site
popup.auto.startConsent: When you open this site, QA Wrap starts recording by itself. It records only what you do on this site, in this browser, shows a dot on the page, and stops after 30 minutes without activity. Untick to turn it off.
popup.auto.shotLabel: Also take a screenshot on the first error of each kind
popup.auto.shotConsent: When this site shows an error it has not shown before in this test, QA Wrap saves a screenshot of the tab you are looking at. Screenshots are not scanned for secrets and stay in this browser.
popup.auto.paused: Paused. Recording by itself starts again at {time}.
popup.auto.idleStopped: Stopped by itself after 30 minutes without activity.
popup.auto.running: Recording started by itself on this site.
welcome.fact.auto: Two things can start by themselves, only on sites you tick: recording, and a screenshot on a new error.
options.auto.head: Recording dot
options.auto.indicator: Show the recording dot on pages
options.auto.indicatorHint: A small dot with the minutes, drawn by QA Wrap while a test is recording. The page cannot see it. The sites that start recording or take screenshots by themselves are listed under Permissions.

__override.options.remembered.title: What each site may do by itself
